info.name: Breaking News Monitor — Phase 3 Posts API
info.description: Protected read-only Posts API checks. Uses the existing baseUrl and admin login environment variables. A successful login stores adminToken. The implemented requireAdmin middleware returns 401 for non-admin-role tokens; no 403 branch exists.

variable.description: Fallback local origin. A selected Postman environment value overrides this collection default.
Filled by Admin login request. Treat as secret; clear after testing.
Optional token for non-admin authorization check. Current backend returns 401 for non-admin role tokens.
Auto-captured from the first result returned by GET Posts – Admin Access when available.
Auto-captured from the first returned post when available; Other is schema-valid fallback.

exec: if (pm.request.url.toString().includes('/api/posts') && pm.response.code === 200) {
let body;
pm.test('Response is valid JSON', function () { body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.be.an('object'); });
if (body) {
pm.test('Posts and pagination follow the API contract', function () {
pm.expect(body.posts).to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(body.pagination).to.be.an('object');
['page', 'limit', 'total', 'totalPages'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(body.pagination).to.have.property(key));
['page', 'limit', 'total', 'totalPages'].forEach((key) => pm.expect(body.pagination[key]).to.be.a('number'));
pm.expect(body.pagination.totalPages).to.eql(body.pagination.total === 0 ? 0 : Math.ceil(body.pagination.total / body.pagination.limit));
pm.test('Post DTO exposes only allowlisted fields', function () {
const validCategories = ['World News', 'Politics', 'Military & Security', 'Economy & Finance', 'Technology', 'Business', 'Emergencies', 'Other'];
const validNotificationStatuses = ['pending', 'sending', 'sent', 'failed', 'skipped'];
body.posts.forEach((post) => {
pm.expect(validCategories).to.include(post.category);
pm.expect(validNotificationStatuses).to.include(post.notificationStatus);
const allowed = ['_id', 'username', 'author', 'text', 'publishedAt', 'postUrl', 'category', 'providerName', 'priority', 'processingStatus', 'notificationStatus', 'telegramSent', 'createdAt'];
body.posts.forEach((post) => {
pm.expect(Object.keys(post).every((key) => allowed.includes(key)), 'unexpected DTO field').to.eql(true);
pm.expect(post.author).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(Object.keys(post.author).every((key) => ['username', 'displayName'].includes(key)), 'unexpected author field').to.eql(true);
pm.test('Published and created timestamps are valid before sort comparison', function () {
const dateValue = (value, field, row) => {
if (value === null && field === 'publishedAt') return null;
const parsed = Date.parse(value);
pm.expect(Number.isNaN(parsed), field + ' must be a valid date in row ' + row).to.eql(false);
return parsed;
body.posts.forEach((post, row) => { dateValue(post.publishedAt, 'publishedAt', row); dateValue(post.createdAt, 'createdAt', row); });
pm.test('Posts sorted by publishedAt, createdAt, and _id descending', function () {
const dateValue = (value) => value === null ? null : Date.parse(value);
const compareDesc = (left, right) => { if (left === right) return 0; if (left === null) return 1; if (right === null) return -1; return left > right ? -1 : 1; };
for (let index = 1; index < body.posts.length; index += 1) {
const previous = body.posts[index - 1]; const current = body.posts[index];
let order = compareDesc(dateValue(previous.publishedAt), dateValue(current.publishedAt));
if (order === 0) order = compareDesc(dateValue(previous.createdAt), dateValue(current.createdAt));
if (order === 0) order = compareDesc(String(previous._id), String(current._id));
pm.expect(order, 'row ' + index + ' is out of order').to.be.at.most(0);

request.description: Uses adminUsername/adminPassword from the selected local Postman environment, matching the Phase 1/2 login flow. Saves the returned JWT as adminToken for this collection and selected environment.

exec: const username = pm.environment.get('adminUsername');
const password = pm.environment.get('adminPassword');
if (typeof username !== 'string' || !username || typeof password !== 'string' || !password) throw new Error('Set adminUsername and adminPassword in the selected local Postman environment.');
pm.variables.set('adminUsernameJson', JSON.stringify(username));
pm.variables.set('adminPasswordJson', JSON.stringify(password));
pm.test('HTTP 200 login', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Login returns the implemented token response', function () { pm.expect(body.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.tokenType).to.eql('Bearer'); pm.expect(body.expiresIn).to.eql(28800); });
if (pm.response.code === 200 && body.accessToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('adminToken', body.accessToken); pm.environment.set('adminToken', body.accessToken); }

request.description: Requires a valid admin JWT in adminToken. Also captures a returned record’s username/category/status for the following conditional filter requests.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 for admin access", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.posts.length) { const post = body.posts[0]; pm.collectionVariables.set('filterUsername', post.username); pm.collectionVariables.set('filterCategory', post.category); pm.collectionVariables.set('filterNotificationStatus', post.notificationStatus); } }

request.description: Sends no Authorization header; requireAdmin should reject the request.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 401 without authentication", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Error response has a clear message', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Conditional authorization check. Supply a correctly signed, unexpired, non-admin JWT in userToken. Empty userToken skips this request. An invalid signature or expired token returns a different error and fails the role check. Current requireAdmin returns 401 for a valid non-admin-role token, not 403; the login API issues admin tokens only.

exec: const suppliedToken = pm.variables.get('userToken');
if (typeof suppliedToken !== 'string' || !suppliedToken.trim()) {
console.warn('Skipped Non-Admin Access: set a valid non-admin JWT in userToken to run this authorization check.');
pm.execution.skipRequest();

pm.test('A valid non-admin JWT is rejected with the implemented 401 role error', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('Invalid authentication token'); });
pm.test('Error response has a clear message', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });

request.description: Returns the first page up to the endpoint maximum. Result count depends on stored posts.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 for all-posts page", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Limit is the requested maximum', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().pagination.limit).to.eql(100); });

request.description: Checks defaults: page 1 and limit 20.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 with default pagination", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Pagination defaults are page 1 and limit 20', function () { const p = pm.response.json().pagination; pm.expect(p.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.limit).to.eql(20); });

request.description: Checks requested page and limit are reflected in the pagination object.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 with custom pagination", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Pagination matches page 2 and limit 10', function () { const p = pm.response.json().pagination; pm.expect(p.page).to.eql(2); pm.expect(p.limit).to.eql(10); });

request.description: Pre-request generates a valid, highly unique username. Expected empty only if no stored posts use that generated username; this is a conditional database-data test.

exec: const suffix = Date.now().toString().slice(-10); pm.collectionVariables.set('emptyTestUsername', 'pm' + suffix);
pm.test("HTTP 200 for empty-result query", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('No matching posts for generated username (conditional)', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().posts).to.be.an('array').that.is.empty; });

request.description: Uses a username captured from GET Posts – Admin Access, or a valid fallback. Conditional on matching records existing.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 for username filter", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const expected = pm.variables.get('filterUsername') || 'phase3test'; pm.test('Every row matches username filter (conditional)', function () { pm.response.json().posts.forEach((post) => pm.expect(post.username.toLowerCase()).to.eql(expected.replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase())); });

item.name: GET Posts – Filter by Username with @ Prefix

request.description: Verifies the controller strips a single leading @ before applying the username filter. Matching records are conditional.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 for @-prefixed username filter", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const expected = pm.variables.get('filterUsername') || 'phase3test'; pm.test('Every row matches @-prefixed username filter (conditional)', function () { pm.response.json().posts.forEach((post) => pm.expect(post.username.toLowerCase()).to.eql(expected.replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase())); });

request.description: Category is captured from a returned post when available, otherwise uses valid schema value Other. Matching data is conditional.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 for category filter", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const expected = pm.variables.get('filterCategory') || 'Other'; pm.test('Every row matches category filter', function () { pm.response.json().posts.forEach((post) => pm.expect(post.category).to.eql(expected)); });

item.name: GET Posts – Filter by Notification Status

request.description: Status is captured from a returned post when available, otherwise uses valid Post schema status pending. Matching data is conditional.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 for notification-status filter", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const expected = pm.variables.get('filterNotificationStatus') || 'pending'; pm.test('Every row matches notification status filter', function () { pm.response.json().posts.forEach((post) => pm.expect(post.notificationStatus).to.eql(expected)); });

request.description: Combines valid username, category, and notificationStatus captured from an existing result where possible. Matching data is conditional.

exec: pm.test("HTTP 200 for combined filters", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

const username = (pm.variables.get('filterUsername') || 'phase3test').replace(/^@/, '').toLowerCase(); const category = pm.variables.get('filterCategory') || 'Other'; const status = pm.variables.get('filterNotificationStatus') || 'pending'; pm.test('Every row matches all combined filters', function () { pm.response.json().posts.forEach((post) => { pm.expect(post.username.toLowerCase()).to.eql(username); pm.expect(post.category).to.eql(category); pm.expect(post.notificationStatus).to.eql(status); }); });
